summary: Check the CAA records of names

requestBody.description: The names and the CA to check them for

acme_server.description: The CA (an ACME directory URL) the certificate would be requested from; default the instance CA. It must be one an administrator has set up

dns_challenge.description: True for the DNS challenge (`dns-01`), false for the HTTP challenge (`http-01`); a `validationmethods` parameter is compared with it

400.description: No name, more than 100, or a CA that is not set up

description:
Reads the CAA records (RFC 8659) of each name: the name itself, then each parent until a set is found, at most 10 levels; a wildcard starts at its base name. It compares them with the CAA identities of the chosen CA (the `caaIdentities` of its ACME directory, else a fixed list for the preset CAs). A name whose CA does not name an identity is `not-checked`. Nothing is written and nothing is cached.

Needs: Certificates view
